new_player.message: Welcome to One Block! Break the block under you.

meta.notes: How the world starts: a World Type called One Block of empty sky (void), listed on the Create New World screen. When the first player joins, the start msm_starter:one_block/start is placed at 0 64 0, the world spawn set on top of it and the player sent there; each new player gets a welcome, once. Everything lowers to plain data pack files.
